title: Nüwa Stone Bridges: Repair Patterns
subtitle: A fictional field atlas of invented stone bridges across a painted valley.

sections.mission: This fictional project explores invented stone bridges across a painted valley. All settings and observations are invented. It links each illustration to field notes so readers can compare the evidence and follow the sequence.
sections.challenge: How can a fictional repair plan show which gaps matter most without hiding uncertainty? A single illustration cannot explain the order of observations or why one interpretation was chosen. Each entry therefore records its place in the sequence, describes what changed, and keeps gaps in the imagined evidence visible.
approach: Arrange illustrated stones into alternate bridge patterns and compare their spans.
impact: Give readers a clear example of tracing a design decision to its source notes.

research.focus: Exploring the imagined themes of Nüwa Stone Bridges: Repair Patterns in a fictional research record. Locations and measurements remain imaginary.
